content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are popular platforms for selling digital products, but they have limitations, especially for creators in restricted countries. These platforms offer varying degrees of functionality, from payment processing to product delivery, but their availability and usability are often hindered by geographical constraints. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH, provides a comprehensive solution that includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, all without relying on restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal have strict policies regarding the countries they operate in, often excluding regions with perceived higher risks. This exclusion results in creators from these countries being unable to use these services, thereby limiting their ability to sell digital products globally. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions are designed to be inclusive, offering alternatives that do not discriminate based on geographical location, thus empowering creators worldwide to participate in digital commerce.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for digital creators. Traditional platforms may charge significant fees, and payment suspensions, like those experienced with PayPal, can hold funds for up to 180 days. In contrast, solutions leveraging cryptocurrencies, such as NOWPayments, offer fast payment verification with minimal fees, typically around 0.5%, and do not require buyers to have an account, making the transaction process smoother and more cost-effective.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to sell digital products without platform restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure prioritizes creator ownership and control over their digital products and customer data. With solutions like COREMERCH, creators can automate their sales process, from payment to product delivery, without relying on third-party platforms that might restrict their access or charge exorbitant fees. This level of autonomy ensures that creators can focus on producing high-quality digital products, knowing they have a reliable and unrestricted sales mechanism in place.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators facing platform restrictions, choosing the right architecture is crucial. Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a permanent, structural alternative to traditional platforms.
